notes.title: SVFI 7.23 Updates
notes.content:
[h2]Important Reminder[/h2]

[*] [Pro Version] Added new "Tariff" VFI models for NVIDIA GPUs: [b]neu2_nb202[/b] (fast model) and [b]neu2_upg[/b] (quality model). Recommended for 1080p resolution only; for higher resolutions, set optical flow scale below 0.5

[/list]

[*] [Pro Version] Removed restriction preventing concurrent use of GMFSS and super-resolution
[*] [Pro Version] Discontinued INT8 quantization support for super-resolution
[*] Changed deinterlacing filter from yadif to bwdif
[*] Removed EMA VFI model
[*] Removed Mmss VFI model
[*] Removed 3x super-resolution models
[*] Other optimizations

[list]
[*] [Pro Version] Fixed cases where super-resolution output resolution didn't match settings
[*] Fixed playback issues for CPU-encoded HEVC videos on Apple devices
[*] Fixed (automatic) black bar cropping
[*] Other fixes
[/list]

[h2]Tutorials and Official Website[/h2]
[list]
[*] https://cn2.svfi.group
[*] https://cn.svfi.group
[*] https://doc.svfi.group
[/list]

notes.title: SVFI 7.7 Updates
notes.content:
[h2]Important New Feature Introduction: Turbo Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significantly increases the speed of certain NVIDIA-specific models, located under [b]Advanced Settings[/b]
[*] RIFE 4.26 VFI model accelerated by [b]210%+[/b]
[*] GmfSs pg104 accelerated by [b]15%+[/b]
[*] DRBA model for VFI of IRL and conservative Anime accelerated by [b]300%+[/b]
[*] Models under the Super Resolution TensorRT algorithm section (with .onnx extensions) receive a general speed boost
[*] [b]Requires purchasing the Pro version[/b]; this option may be incompatible with certain settings
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [For Community Members] Supports dragging the error.log file directly into SVFI to load settings
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations and Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The surveillance folder can now automatically detect and add newly introduced videos as new tasks, regardless of their creation time
[*] Improved the display of vertical video posters within the software
[*] Silent Mode now only affects the popup that appears after a task is completed. During task startup, a confirmation window will always appear to prevent unreasonable configurations
[*] Allows the computer screen to turn off while the software is running
[*] [Pro Version] The official_trt series VFI models have been replaced by Turbo Mode
[*] Other optimizations
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]   
[list]
[*] Fixed the finishing operations after task completion so they now update in real time according to preferences
[*] Fixed an issue where custom output filenames could sometimes cause errors
[*] Restored support for some older VFI models
[*] Other fixes
[/list]

[h2]Tutorials and Official Website[/h2]
[list]
[*] https://cn2.svfi.group
[*] https://cn.svfi.group
[*] https://doc.svfi.group
[/list]

notes.title: SVFI Season Beta
notes.content:
[h1]SVFI 6.18.3 Public Beta Release[/h1]

Compared to the official version, the content currently in public beta is as follows:
[olist]
[*] [Professional Edition] Image sequence with a transparent channel and video support. Note that the image sequence needs to be saved as png or tiff, and the video will be forced to be exported using Apple ProRes 4444 yuva444p12le to retain the transparent channel; the speed of super-resolution and frame interpolation tasks will be halved because the transparent channel is treated as an independent video stream for processing.
[*] [Professional Edition] NVIDIA RTX one-click HDR and fast super-resolution model. The NVIDIA APP needs to be installed.
[*] SAIN frame interpolation model
[*] RIFE 4.18 frame interpolation model
[/olist]

Problems that have been attempted to be fixed but are still in public beta for verification:

[olist]
[*] [Professional Edition] When the super-resolution ratio (e.g., 2x) does not match the model ratio (e.g., 4x), the output has a mosaic screen.
[*] [Professional Edition] The output screen of RIFE TensorRT has jagged edges.
[/olist]

Interested friends, please go to the SVFI library page - Properties - Beta section, and pull down "beta" to enter the public beta.

notes.title: SVFI 6.8 Updates
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A more streamlined [b]Advanced Settings[/b] interface. The order of options from left to right remains unchanged. To use the previous advanced settings layout, check [b]Preferences - Classic Advanced Settings[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/117fa697ae6feac26b4c9e9688f43df71733c0c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/f1da94633ea825f482a82ec8403a4b6cdc7e25b7.png[/img]
[*] The task input list now includes a [b]Unknown Color Space[/b] label. This label indicates that the input video does not have a known color transfer characteristic to assist SVFI in correcting color shift. Manual adjustments are required in the [b]Output Settings[/b] under [b]Advanced Settings[/b], specifically in [b]Custom Color Transfer[/b]. Generally, bt709 is the default for most 1080p videos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/ec948f14aac15d92b993a95f453fa823b65a7684.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/59d746d72a7355f7d182a0b685cd37cadb27f42d.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]   
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the UI crashes in some cases after terminating a task.
[*] Fixed an issue where video previews would not play correctly in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue with the TensorRT super-resolution module with tiling reporting errors in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where constant frame rate mp4 files were merged into variable frame rate files in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue in multi-threading mode where it was not possible to specify the super-resolution working graphics card.
[*] Other bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: SVFI 6.0 Updates
notes.content:
[h1]SVFI 6.0 Release:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] New application interface, newly designed preferences page, supporting custom theme colors and custom background images

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/b4d7c5855ab2141e45f8bb7b53c6a6ee188657f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/96fe1d3a06021cdbe6f87b54614f77ebcd5e8421.png[/img]
[*] Player preview and VFI mask drawing support, area covered by the mask will not be processed in VFI (keep static), suitable for games with HUD (crosshair, control panel, etc.) VFI task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/a4a46134c97fa67ab0351c59cb981daf4fbe7667.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/10f0b76113a75608d8cc21869eb7a8223ddbb872.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/3f3bcac71f9f49ee8d250cbfa1fe5d54d9c289c8.png[/img]
[*] [b]PRO: [/b]Fast models exclusively for NVIDIA card CUDA core acceleration of [b]TensorRT[/b] for CUGAN, RealESRGAN super-resolution models. Choose [b]cugan[/b], [b]realesr[/b] under the [b]TensorRT[/b] column of super-resolution model selection to use. Changing super-resolution settings requires compilation for these models, please wait patiently for 15 to 20 minutes to achieve more than double acceleration. The new model settings correspond to the old model settings, it's recommended to use the previously well-adjusted super-resolution settings. It's recommended to use graphics cards with 6GB or more video memory. Please make good use of the preset function.
[*] [b]PRO: [/b][b]TensorRT [/b] now supports 8-bit quantization of related models, which can further improve speed, recommended for super-resolution models. It's advised to first compile non-int8 trt accelerated models before trying under int8 mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/cd46b193f2b416bb5136840a095d86baf4f2c9e0.png[/img]
[*] [b]PRO: [/b][b]TensorRT [/b] supports tiling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/ae018f235489f6f4ed0de0aac2dc73e0554fa05c.png[/img]
[*] [b]PRO: [/b]RIFE 4.6, RIFE 4.7 RIFE 4.8 VFI models accelerated by [b]TensorRT [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40952458/c97b3acc7147292868d85f67565eb9f0c368f92d.png[/img]
[/olist]

[h1]Important Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Old version of SVFI 3.23.1 has been uploaded to test branch [u]revision-8[/u]. If anyone insists using old version, please go to the SVFI library page - Properties - Test branch dropdown, select "revision-8" to enter the old version of SVFI. Please do remind to add SVFI installation directory to whitelist of your anti-virus software, and remove the files marked as malware from sandbox in anti-virus settings.
[/list]

Fast models exclusively for NVIDIA card CUDA core acceleration of TensorRT for CUGAN, RealESRGAN super-resolution models.
TensorRT now supports 8-bit quantization of related models, which can further improve speed, recommended for super-resolution models.
TensorRT supports tiling.
RIFE 4.6, RIFE 4.7 RIFE 4.8 VFI models accelerated by TensorRT

notes.title: SVFI New Years Update
notes.content:
[h2]What's New[/h2]
     - Add [b]RIFE 4.0[/b] Model for [b]NVIDIA [/b]Users, Dramatic Speed with Great Result.
     - Add [b]WaifuCuda [/b]Super Resolution Model (inherited from [b]Waifu2x[/b]), better speed and performance  against Waifu2x
     - Add 16bit High-Precision Workflow Mode, [b]interpolate all of your footage in 16bit[/b] (VIDEO ONLY), reduce artifacts of encoding like banding, [b]improve HDR output[/b].
     - Add [b]One-Click HDR[/b] function to improve your video, make your SDR(BT709) into HDR10(BT2020)!
     - Add [b]Zero-Latency-Decode Encode Presets[/b], No need to worry about the decoding performance of your VR equipments.
     - Add [b]Batch Mode[/b] for Render-Only and Extract-Only Mission
     - Add [b]Preview Window[/b] during the interpolation, help you better understand what is being carried on during the enduring process. You can enable it in your [b]Preference Settings[/b].
     - Add Mission Status Hint Bar, help you better diagnose your bottleneck in VFI.
     - Add Pop-up Check [b]before [/b]quitting GUI
[h2]What's Fixed[/h2]
    - Fix Custom Presets Not covering all options
    - Fix Color Shifting at Render Process, FFmpeg Only
    - Fix Color Tag missing when concatenating videos
    - Fix failure of options update after changing task id in the main menu.
    - Fix Global Settings Unable to apply at the last items
    - Fix Malfunction of Resize Option after assigning Crop parameters along with custom output resolution
    - Fix Output PNG Sequence with incorrect resolution with Crop parameters
    - Fix Normalization of Image failure during non-output process (scene detection)
    - Fix output png sequence number partly missing in output image sequence mode
    - Fix "Unable to find file" error occured by os.devnull (skvideo module)
    - Fix “Not find proc attribute” error (skvideo module)
    - Fix some minor bugs on UI
    - Fix Decode(Read) Time Display (RPT in the commanline bar in the output window)
[h2]Some Optimization[/h2]
    - Optimize Encode Presets.
    - Optimize RIFE Module Log Display
    - Optimize Scikit Video Read Frame Process
    - Optimize Status Bar logic
    - Optimize Super Resolution Settings Structure by adding more selective options
    - Optimize Quitting Process at when finishing interpolation tasks.
    - Optimize VFI Module Options Display
    - Optimize Output Filename Rule
    - Optimize RIFE Reversed Flow Mode
[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
    - Update Software Instructions
    - Update HDR10/HDR10+ Metadata
    - Update UI Description(Readme) and Widgets' Tootips
    - Remove Plural limit for crop parameters
